rationale: The recorded decision establishes a hard ceiling of 2 concurrent workers for the current upstream account. A previous load test confirmed that 4 workers caused retries and degraded throughput, so 4 and 8 are ruled out. No new load test or account-limit change has been recorded, so that constraint is still active. Setting worker_count to 2 doubles throughput over the current value of 1 — directly addressing the 8-feed backlog — while staying within the proven safe limit.
